findings: Dead dark-variant branches in AppShell.tsx and TopNavBar.tsx retain old tokens (border-border-subtle, bg-space-void, text-text-primary, font-display, accent-orbit). These branches are unreachable because no screen currently passes variant="dark", but the AppShell default is still "dark" — a future screen missing the explicit variant="light" prop would silently regress to the old dark theme. Recommend either removing the dark branches or changing the default variant to "light".
